**Implementation note:** Session-anchored VWAP only; no event anchors.

## Description

Anchors VWAP to a known event (earnings, swing low/high, open) and trades reclaim/rejection of that volume-weighted reference.

## Where it may fit

Intraday price discovery around a meaningful event or reference point; most useful with adequate traded volume.

## Vehicles

Equities, ETFs, futures; discretionary-to-systematic intraday strategies.

## Required data

Timestamped trades or intraday OHLCV with volume; exact anchor-event timestamp and session calendar.

## Caveats

Anchor selection can be subjective and hindsight-biased; predefine event anchors and intraday fill assumptions.
